title: coding-study concept guide meta.yaml
description: Metadata of one concept guide in guides/<slug>/; the folder's name is the slug. Spec: docs/specs/guides.md#metayaml. coding_study.adapters.fs_guide_catalog reads the same shape.

title.description: The guide's # heading repeats it (check G3)

level.description: intro: the first idea of a topic; core: what working engineers use daily; advanced: designs and guarantees beyond the basics

domains.description: What the guide is about, from the closed list problems use (docs/specs/guides.md#labels)

job_roles.description: Who the guide is for; general is any software engineer (docs/specs/guides.md#labels)

prerequisites.description: Guides to read first; they form no cycle (check G5)

problems.description: Problems that practice the guide, in the order to try them; each is named in ## Practice (check G4)

shell.description: The guide's topic is the shell: its examples may have a bash variant, and aim for bash and the six languages (docs/specs/guides.md#shell-guides)
